description: VAZÃO F36 (docs/programs/vazao/design-trem.md §3): the most PRs a batch on the box takes, k_max, by the observed red share p of the gate (VAZÃO F24, scripts/flow-metrics) over the last train.batch_red_window merged PRs. The first row whose red_max p does not pass gives k_max; past the last row k_max is 1 (no batch). Rows go in ascending red_max; each size must fit train.bisection_max_runs (ceil(log2 size) runs), and k_max never passes train.batch_size. The rows come from a Monte Carlo of the prefix policy with the proven prefix merged (gate runs per resolved PR: 0.30 at p 0.05 and k 8, 0.57 at p 0.133 and k 4, 0.76 at p 0.20 and k 2).
